   Causica combines graph and neural-mechanism fitting within an additive-noise structural
model, then simulates interventions (microsoft contributors, 2026). This is a useful comparison
where the structural restrictions are justified. A variational graph distribution conditional
on that model is not a frequentist graph-confidence set or a distribution-free certificate of
causal identification. The current README explicitly says Rhino and DDECI were removed
from the codebase and refers to an earlier release. Their paper descriptions cannot establish
the capability of the current snapshot. The initial CausalNex repository retrieval failed; that
historical failure is not evidence that the project is abandoned (quantumblacklabs contributors,
2026). The later pinned-source comparison recovers its StructureModel and selected NOTEARS
implementations. Default adoption remains deferred pending a justified consumer, an isolated
compatible environment and dependency qualification; source retrieval itself is no longer the
obstacle (mckinsey/causalnex, 2026).


17.7      Data organization must preserve what was known
DuckDB and Polars provide relational and columnar execution paths; Pandera supplies explicit
schema and value checks (duckdb contributors, 2026b; pola-rs contributors, 2026; unionai-oss
contributors, 2026). These are useful building blocks for Chapter 11, but type-correct data
may still encode the wrong decision history. An event dated before a credit-limit decision may
have reached the bank after it. A later corrected value can also replace the value actually
used. The history constructor must therefore enforce event, availability and revision semantics
before exporting predictors to an estimator.
   Feast’s inspected historical-retrieval API makes the distinction concrete. It uses event time
and TTL, and offers filter_by_created_timestamp. The latter defaults to false; when true it
excludes later-created values only for feature views with a configured creation-timestamp field
(feast-dev contributors, 2026). Hence it is incorrect either to assume every point-in-time join
captures actual availability or to claim this capability is entirely absent. The bank must map
its availability semantics to the configured fields and test a backfill whose event precedes, but
creation follows, the decision. TTL governs freshness and retrieval scope; it cannot establish
that mapping.
   DataHub and OpenMetadata can supply asset descriptions, ownership, glossaries and lineage
(datahub-project contributors, 2026; open-metadata contributors, 2026). Their graphs record
how data are described and produced; they are not causal graphs of the customer or economy.
A transform that computes arrears from transactions produces a lineage edge, not evidence
that editing the arrears column would change past transactions. The product should reuse
the bank’s catalog and attach the causal interpretation to its stable asset identifiers. Broad
catalog marketing that mixes open-source and managed-cloud features is not evidence that a
particular local deployment has those features.
   OpenLineage supplies an extensible run/job/dataset event model (OpenLineage contributors,
2026). A causal-analysis extension should preserve the target, data snapshot, observation
clock, model/graph, split plan and estimator identity. These are proposed scientific facets, not
standard causal semantics already supplied by OpenLineage. Splink addresses another part
of the observation operator: probabilistic linkage supplies pair probabilities and estimated
entity clusters (moj-analytical-services contributors, 2026). Their uncertainty matters when a
false household merge changes the unit of treatment or uses post-treatment information. The

into another package. The selected source establishes a component and an inspection route; it
does not establish the complete causal workflow.
  A useful banking support diagnostic asks whether both proposed incentive levels occur
with adequate conditional support among the intended customers. The normal model can
assign positive density far beyond observed incentive choices; mathematical positivity of a
parametric density is not evidence of practical overlap. Reporting density values together
with observed range, local support and model sensitivity is more informative than presenting
a successful fit as permission to extrapolate. The observed package declaration is GPL-3;
complete dependency and redistribution choices remain part of adoption review.

   The choice of dose grid also matters for decision support. If a business constraint permits
only three incentive levels, interpolation at arbitrary levels has no immediate operating
interpretation. If the optimum is selected from a dense grid using the same fitted surface,
uncertainty in that selection is not the same as pointwise uncertainty at a fixed dose. A package
comparison should therefore distinguish fixed contrasts, whole curves and policy optimization,
and explain which one is actually supported.
   The observed DESCRIPTION declares MIT plus a separate LICENSE file. The initial
documentation review did not include that accompanying notice or a complete implementation
review (causaldrf project, 2026b). The later source review recovered and inspected the notice,
identifying the year and copyright holder (causaldrf project, 2026a). The appropriate decision
remains a provisional reference or adapter candidate: full implementation, interval behavior
and transitive dependency terms still require qualification. A recovered notice is not a complete
dependency inventory, and documented point estimation is not evidence of qualified confidence
intervals.
